items.title: Billy Bauer interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Chubby Jackson, Bill Harris, Flip Phillips, there was quite a crew in that band. [INTERVIEWEE] Well everybody at that time thought it was one of the swingingest bands.

ctx.x: A neutral country. They didn’t want to say that they were behind it you know. And then in the USO, it was a hundred dollars a week too, but nothing else. And if anybody, if you were in battle, you weren’t shooting, but if you were in battle, your job, besides playing, was to pick up all the wounded or the dead. That was it. I mean you had to do that. I’m glad they didn’t shoot me.
Chubby Jackson, Bill Harris, Flip Phillips, there was quite a crew in that band.
Well everybody at that time thought it was one of the swingingest bands. Especially for Offays. Do you know what Offays were?
